conclusion: Many missing standalone masks have supplied costume images available, but none of these become canonical or publisher-certified by filename or old technical validation. Source-matched extractions are possible as explicitly unapproved studies of the supplied costumes. Exact canonical generation remains dependent on actual trusted reference views; historical licensed photos/screenshots named in the receipts were not found in the repository or searched local workspace/tmp.
